ca46b04a-3067-46ad-a547-de3191a5babf/Eve.en: "Hold on, hold on!<NL>A Xia like you, so bold, so unrestrained,<NL>has all virtues in place, save for one thing... a fine new outfit to match!"<NL><NL>A "People of Wanqu" appears gracefully in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, speaking with delight.<NL>The person then draws a few shimmering robes from the pocket,<NL>and press them eagerly into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hands...

9f17ab29-b247-45c3-99ca-9de13fd2cc49/Eve.en: "To wander the Martial World, one must not be without silk and splendor!<NL>My companions and I tailored this set just for you.<NL>May your heart be light, your journey smooth, and your path free across the mountains and rivers. May you witness all the world's beauty and wonder."<NL><NL>Having said that, the "People of Wanqu" clumsily strikes a few mock martial poses,<NL>then bows with cupped fists and vanishes from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s sight in the blink of an eye...
